Forward-port release scripts, workflows, policy data and executable policy tests from protected main 8d070b7de7fb9164477446f6713ce5a0aef083bd into prerelease/0.9.x. All 34 authority blobs exactly match that protected commit. Retain the published 0.8.1 recovery notes and withdrawal notice for 0.8.0, and document matching-tag manual retries.

The version remains 0.9.0, package-lock and product files are unchanged, and the before/after product digest is identical: 54da7b7cd7172ad3322e2bba21035d4ea074dc0a05744090252272650707fcbc. Supporting changes are the policy-test command and the prerelease-only packaging test's stale release-history assertions. Those assertions now require stable 0.8.1, the compatibility recovery, withdrawn 0.8.0 and unpublished 0.9.x; they no longer require 0.8.0 to be current stable.

Validation: 247 policy cases passed locally; the old metadata assertion reproduced RED, then all 26 package-asset cases passed after correction. Types, lint, production build and exact authority/product checks passed. The shared evaluator accepts the source as the prerelease feature route. All five final hosted checks, native guard, refreshed independent whole-branch review and automated code/security review passed on exact source 41dd886. No new runtime enforcement logic is authored here.

Related to #157; remaining live evidence and its forward-port must finish before that issue closes.

Tracking: [issue #157](https://github.com/glitchwerks/vscode-claude-workspaces/issues/157).

This documentation-only PR exercises the protected-main Release Guard and the
single-entry main merge queue approved in
[PR #159](https://github.com/glitchwerks/vscode-claude-workspaces/pull/159).

The live verification must record the original PR, selected workflow revision,
queue identity, prospective tree, required check results and final squash
identity in issue #157 before declaring enforcement complete. A rejected probe
remains open and can be retried after its cause is addressed.

Remove this temporary probe document after the reviewed rollout receipt is
merged and issue #157 closes.

# Queue membership and stale-run probe B

This temporary documentation-only probe supports the multiple-entry rejection
and withdrawn/stale-run tests tracked in
[issue #157](https://github.com/glitchwerks/vscode-claude-workspaces/issues/157).
It must remain open and retryable when queue evidence rejects. Remove this
document after the rollout receipt is merged and issue #157 closes.

# Queue membership control probe C

This temporary documentation-only control supports the multiple-entry negative
test and a separately reviewed sole-entry main advance under
[issue #157](https://github.com/glitchwerks/vscode-claude-workspaces/issues/157).
It must not merge during the multiple-entry negative test. Remove this document
after the rollout receipt is merged and issue #157 closes.

# Prerelease and retarget live probe

Tracking: [issue #157](https://github.com/glitchwerks/vscode-claude-workspaces/issues/157).

This documentation-only change starts as an ordinary PR to prerelease/0.9.x.
After its native guard and required checks pass, the same source commit will be
retargeted to main to verify that earlier green results cannot authorize a main
merge. Restore the prerelease target after recording the rejection.

The probe preserves the prerelease product tree. Its ancestry includes the
reviewed main revision so that a Git conflict cannot substitute for the required
live routing rejection. The source commit remains unchanged during retargeting.

Remove this temporary document when the rollout is recorded and issue #157
closes.
